jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Dynamic Solution Innovators (DSi), a Dhaka-based software company, is hiring a Business Analyst with 1–3 years of experience. The role covers requirements analysis, process mapping, documentation, and client collaboration across pre-sales and project delivery, from opportunity assessment to final handover.

## Responsibilities

- Gather client needs, pain points, and expected outcomes through meetings, workshops, and site visits as needed.
- Document As-Is and To-Be processes, feature lists, epics, user stories, inception reports, and UI/UX flows.
- Work with the Documentation Team to develop Software Requirements Specifications (SRS) and Software Design Documents (SDD).
- Validate processes, workflows, and UI/UX designs with clients throughout the analysis phase.
- Collaborate with Sales and Tech Leads on project scoping, requirements discovery, and initial solution planning.
- Prepare scoping documents, milestone structures, and risk assessments, and develop effort estimates with Tech Lead support.
- Contribute technical content and process and architecture diagrams to RFP/EOI responses.
- Keep Project Managers, developers, QA, and UI/UX teams aligned on requirements throughout delivery. Provide ongoing clarifications and maintain accurate, consistent requirements as systems evolve.
- Lead client requirement walkthroughs, validation and feedback sessions, and presentations of workflows, prototypes, and To-Be processes to align stakeholders.
- Support Project Managers during user acceptance testing (UAT), piloting, and deployment.

## Requirements

- Have 1–3 years of experience.
- Communicate effectively in English and Bengali, explaining complex ideas clearly and concisely.
- Demonstrate strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
- Organize information logically and produce clear, structured documentation.
- Have hands-on experience with business analysis documentation, including SRS, Business Requirements Documents (BRD), and As-Is and To-Be process documents.
- Show an interest in software systems and enthusiasm for organizing and documenting technical processes.
- Be proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, Google Sheets, and other productivity or collaboration tools.
- Have strong computer literacy and be willing to learn new technologies and tools quickly.
- Manage time effectively and handle multiple deliverables in parallel.

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience with Government of Bangladesh (GoB) projects is a plus.
- A bachelor’s degree in BBA, CS, CSE, EEE, ETE, or a related field is preferred.

## Work arrangements

- There are 2 weekly holidays: Friday and Saturday.
- Site visits may be required for requirements gathering.

## Salary and benefits

- Receive free lunch and snacks on campus.
- Receive 2 festival bonuses, healthcare coverage, and a yearly salary increment.
- Work alongside experienced professionals on international and government-level projects.
- Join a supportive environment that encourages learning.

## How to apply

The application deadline is 30 Oct 2026.

jobs.title: Assistant/Associate Software Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
Dynamic Solution Innovators (DSi), a Dhaka-based software company serving international clients since 2001, is hiring Assistant/Associate Software Quality Assurance Engineers. The vacancy was posted on 20 Sep 2026, with a deadline of 29 Oct 2026.

## Responsibilities

- Review requirements, specifications, and technical designs, and provide timely QA feedback.
- Independently prepare detailed, comprehensive, and structured test plans and test cases for assigned modules or features.
- Design, execute, and maintain manual and automated tests, analyze results, and investigate the root causes of failures.
- Document, track, and report bugs with clear reproduction steps, and follow them through to closure.
- Monitor debugging, verify fixes before release, and perform regression, integration, and post-release or post-implementation testing.
- Help develop and improve test automation scripts and frameworks.
- Collaborate with development, product, and DevOps teams to maintain quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
- Support and mentor junior QA engineers as needed, share best practices, and review their test materials.
- Participate in sprint planning, estimation, and retrospectives, contributing QA input to project timelines.

## Requirements

- Have 2–4 years of hands-on experience in software quality assurance or testing.
- Hold a B.Sc. in Computer Science or a relevant degree.
- Demonstrate strong attention to detail and proven experience writing clear, concise, and comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies.
- Have strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes, including functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing.
- Have working knowledge of test management software such as TestRail, Zephyr, qTest, or similar tools.
- Have practical experience with API testing tools such as Postman.
- Have working knowledge of Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright, including the ability to write and maintain basic automated test scripts.
- Understand programming or scripting languages such as Java, JavaScript, Python, or others.
- Have experience with bug tracking and project management tools such as Jira.
- Demonstrate analytical thinking, strong problem-solving ability, and excellent troubleshooting and debugging skills.
- Communicate technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and have excellent organizational skills.
- Work independently, take ownership of assigned modules or features, and collaborate effectively across teams.

Preferred qualifications include:

- Experience mentoring or guiding junior QA engineers.
- Experience building or contributing to automation frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright.
- Experience with performance or load testing tools such as JMeter.
- Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into build pipelines.
- Basic SQL knowledge for data validation and backend testing.
- Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.

## Salary and benefits

- DSi offers a competitive salary, with no amount specified.
- Employees receive free on-campus lunch and snacks, two festival bonuses, yearly increments, and healthcare coverage.
- The role offers a modern, dynamic work environment and opportunities to work with current technologies and frameworks.

jobs.title: Divisional Sector Specialist, Microinsurance; Microfinance Programme

jobs.title: Extension Officer, Microinsurance; Microfinance Programme

jobs.title: Senior Officer, Administration; Microfinance Programme

jobs.title: Senior Officer, Mental Health, BRAC Health Programme (BHP)
jobs.description:

jobs.title: WASH Expert; RIVER-CEMRCB Project; Disaster Risk Management
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Strategy & Value Consultant - Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Optimizely is hiring a Strategy & Value Consultant – Data Analyst for its Strategy and Value Consulting team in Dhaka, Bangladesh. This hands-on technical role owns the data and analysis behind customer benchmarks, value models, and research. You will work within a revenue-facing consulting team, support enterprise value discussions, and help build its analytical infrastructure. A dedicated colleague handles research writing.

## Responsibilities

- Map and document product usage, customer, CRM, and third-party data sources, including schemas, definitions, data granularity, coverage, and known quality issues.
- Build analysis-ready tables and data models, and maintain consistent metric definitions across dashboards, value models, and published research.
- Validate data, reconcile it against source systems, and monitor for failures.
- Develop repeatable extraction, transformation, and loading pipelines using APIs, flat files, and third-party datasets. Convert one-off analyses into maintained datasets with automated refreshes.
- Optimize queries and models for large tables, and document transformations so published figures can be traced to their sources.
- Conduct segmentation, cohort, time-series, significance, correlation, and regression analyses on large datasets.
- Develop the quantitative basis for industry benchmarks, maturity models, and industry-specific value models.
- Provide datasets, analyses, and methodology notes for white papers and research reports in partnership with the colleague responsible for writing them.
- Maintain internal dashboards covering customer benchmarks, performance metrics, and presales reporting. Enable stakeholders to access recurring reports themselves.
- Serve as the team’s primary data resource, clarify stakeholder requirements, and ensure data accuracy and consistency.
- Work with Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Revenue Operations to obtain data and understand how it is generated.
- Explain methods, assumptions, and limitations to non-technical colleagues, and support active enterprise sales opportunities with analysis for tailored customer briefs.

## Requirements

**Required qualifications**

- Have 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer, or Data Engineer.
- Have advanced SQL skills, including window functions, CTEs, complex joins, and query optimization for large tables.
- Demonstrate experience turning raw data into analysis-ready tables and integrating disparate sources, including APIs and semi-structured formats such as JSON.
- Be proficient in Python or R for data manipulation and statistical analysis.
- Have hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.
- Have strong working knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, or Looker for dashboard development.

Commure (Bangladesh Operations) is hiring a Sales Development Representative to generate sales opportunities for its healthcare AI platform. The role involves engaging potential customers, qualifying their needs, and booking product demonstrations while working closely with the US-based Sales team and Account Executives.

## Responsibilities

- Research potential customers and identify relevant decision-makers within target organizations.
- Contact prospects through phone calls, email, LinkedIn, and other appropriate channels, communicating clearly and confidently in English.
- Understand prospects’ needs, challenges, and interests, assess their fit for Commure’s solutions, and explain product value.
- Schedule qualified product demonstrations and sales meetings for Account Executives.
- Follow up consistently with interested prospects who are not yet ready to engage.
- Keep accurate, timely records of prospect interactions, follow-ups, and meeting outcomes in sales systems.
- Brief Account Executives on prospects before meetings and coordinate smooth handoffs of qualified opportunities.
- Work toward defined activity and performance targets for outreach, qualified meetings, and sales opportunities generated.
- Continue developing knowledge of the products, customers, market, and sales process.
- Follow information security policies, protect organizational assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction, or interference, and comply with requirements concerning security processes and activities. Report confirmed or potential security events and other risks to the information security office, and attest to these obligations upon hire and annually.

## Requirements

- You must have excellent spoken and written English, strong interpersonal skills, and the confidence to engage customers.
- You must be proactive and persistent, with strong listening and questioning skills to understand customer needs.
- You must be able to learn complex products and explain their value simply and persuasively.
- You must have a strong interest in a Sales and Business Development career and be comfortable in a target-driven, performance-focused environment.
- You must be organized and able to manage multiple prospects and follow-ups.
- You must be willing to make outbound calls and have frequent customer conversations.
- You must be able to collaborate effectively with a US-based Sales organization and adapt to a fast-paced environment.
- A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred.

The following are also preferred:

- Experience in Sales, Business Development, Lead Generation, Customer Success, Customer Service, or a similar customer-facing role.
- Experience with outbound calling, prospecting, lead qualification, or appointment setting.
- Familiarity with CRM or sales engagement tools.
- Understanding of B2B and B2C sales processes.
- Experience working with US-based customers or stakeholders.
- Exposure to healthcare, health technology, RCM, or SaaS.

## Work arrangements

- The role follows a night shift from 10:00 pm BST to 7:00 am BST.
- Workdays are Monday to Friday.

## Hiring process

- Official communications come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@commure.com**. Emails from other domains are not affiliated with Commure.

jobs.title: Senior Data Operations Analyst (Bangladesh)
jobs.description:
Commure’s Bangladesh Operations team is hiring a Senior Data Operations Analyst for its RCM Global Operations team. The role focuses on keeping operational processes and data accurate and reliable, helping healthcare providers work more efficiently through quality assurance, analysis, documentation, and collaboration.

## Responsibilities

- Conduct thorough quality assurance checks on operational processes, with a standard of zero errors.
- Follow detailed procedures and keep process documentation comprehensive and current.
- Analyze large datasets using SQL and other tools to identify discrepancies, maintain data integrity, improve processes, and support business decisions.
- Create clear instructions and process documents covering both simple and complex tasks.
- Explain complex topics clearly in writing and verbally.
- Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Account Management to maintain quality standards and resolve emerging issues.
- Follow the organization’s information security policies, including protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction, or interference. Report confirmed or potential security events and other risks to the information security office, and attest to these requirements upon hire and annually. The advert also states that employees must not “execute particular security processes or activities,” without specifying which activities this covers.

## Requirements

- Have 2–3 years of experience in engineering or a technical role related to data analysis.
- Hold a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field, or have equivalent work experience.
- Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and the ability to identify discrepancies and ensure accuracy.
- Be proficient in SQL for querying and analyzing data, including large datasets.
- Be able to create, maintain, and follow detailed process documentation.
- Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Take full ownership of responsibilities and consistently deliver high-quality work.
- Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, changing environment, managing ambiguity, and pursuing continuous improvement.

## Work arrangements

- Work Monday to Friday.
- Work the night shift from 10:00 pm, BST to 7:00 am, BST.

## Hiring process

- Official communication comes exclusively from email addresses ending in **@commure.com**. Emails from other domains are not affiliated with Commure.

jobs.title: Assistant/Associate Key Account Manager (SO/EO), Merchant Business-Cards Division
Corporate Security Manager, Leaf
jobs.description:
JTI Bangladesh is hiring a Corporate Security Manager, Leaf in Kushtia to lead security for its Bangladesh Leaf operations and assigned area of responsibility. The role supports the Corporate Security Strategy through risk-based, cost-effective security programs and hands-on operational support.

## Responsibilities

- Develop, review and maintain security programs, processes, practices and policies that reduce risk, respond to incidents and limit exposure and liability. Maintain a Security Risk Register and recommend improvements based on local trends and best practices.
- Serve as an alternate member of the Crisis Management Team, providing operational security and investigative support when required, alongside crisis and incident management training for site and market teams.
- Manage and develop security teams, working with site security representatives and selected vendors to protect executives, employees, stakeholders and visitors at work and during business travel within the assigned area.
- Support personnel working in high-risk environments through personal protection, pre-travel and in-country briefings, residential security surveys, event security, ground and air transport advice, meet-and-greet assistance and special-project guidance.
- Assess and improve physical security arrangements, help develop security audit plans, conduct audits and assessments, and follow up on recommendations.
- Support supply chain security programs to protect operations, products and brand integrity, and advise on reducing losses and brand erosion.
- Undertake background checks, due diligence and objective investigations into security-related allegations or incidents, coordinating with relevant functions as directed.
- Maintain relationships with Leaf management and factory leads, build networks across functions and levels to advance global security initiatives, and brief factory leads on security issues and emerging threats.
- Build relationships with senior law enforcement contacts, security and intelligence agencies, business partners, international counterparts and private-sector security professionals. Participate in relevant public and private security associations.
- Plan and present the annual security budget, including LE, ASP and SAC, provide regular outlook updates, and report year-to-date actuals and variances.
- Oversee local security vendor contracts covering guarding, technology, specialist consulting and investigative support.
- Provide additional security services and support anywhere within Bangladesh as directed by the Country Corporate Security Manager.

## Requirements

- A university degree or equivalent professional experience, supported by demonstrated achievements, is required.
- Candidates must have at least 5 years of relevant experience in military, law enforcement, intelligence, corporate security or related environments.
- Excellent written and spoken English is required. Knowledge of additional regional languages is an asset.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint, is required.

## Work arrangements

- This is a permanent role in the Corporate Security function, based in Kushtia, Bangladesh.
- The position reports to the Country Corporate Security Manager and may require security support elsewhere in Bangladesh.

## Hiring process

Selected applicants should expect the following stages within 1–3 weeks of the job posting’s closure:

- Phone screening with a Talent Advisor.
- Assessment tests.
- Interviews.
- Offer.

Each stage is eliminatory, and the process may vary by role type.

## How to apply

The position will remain open until filled. Applicants who need specific support, alternative formats or other accessibility arrangements should let JTI know.

jobs.title: Senior Information Security Analyst, GRC
jobs.description:

- Own SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance from control design through remediation tracking and auditor coordination.
- Act as the GRC contact for employees, customers, prospects, and auditors.
- Automate evidence collection, control monitoring, and compliance reporting.
- Design and operate vendor risk management, including assessment methods, risk tiers, and ongoing monitoring using automation and/or AI.
- Turn compliance requirements into practical technical specifications for engineering teams.
- Identify and implement AI and LLM tools for security questionnaires, evidence analysis, policy drafting, and control gap detection.

- Have at least 5 years of experience in GRC or adjacent roles.
- Have a strong background in auditing or securing AWS cloud environments and SaaS technologies such as GitHub and Salesforce.
- Have technical expertise in designing, implementing, validating, and scaling security controls and programs for SOC 2 and ISO 27001, alongside expert knowledge of these and other security compliance frameworks.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager

jobs.title: Head of Audit
jobs.description:
NRBC Bank PLC. is hiring a Head of Audit to lead independent, risk-based internal audit and inspection activities and assess the effectiveness of the bank’s controls, risk management, governance, and operations. There is 01 (One) vacancy at Senior Vice President (SVP) / Executive Vice President (EVP) rank.

## Responsibilities

- Develop and implement a Risk-Based Internal Audit (RBIA) framework and Annual Audit Plan covering branches, sub-branches, Head Office divisions and departments, business units, subsidiaries, digital channels, and all other auditable areas.
- Lead audits and inspections to assess the adequacy, effectiveness, and efficiency of internal controls, operational processes, risk management, and governance.
- Ensure comprehensive audit coverage of credit, general banking, cash, foreign exchange, trade finance, treasury, cards, digital banking, procurement, finance, HR, and other critical operations.
- Oversee credit audits covering appraisal, approval, documentation, disbursement, monitoring, classification, provisioning, recovery, rescheduling/restructuring, collateral management, and compliance with delegated authority and regulatory requirements.
- Assess the reliability and integrity of financial and operational information and check whether transactions and activities follow approved policies, procedures, regulations, and delegated authorities.
- Conduct or supervise assigned investigations into suspected fraud, forgery, misappropriation, financial irregularities, unauthorized transactions, policy violations, control failures, and other misconduct.
- Coordinate with specialist resources to audit Core Banking Systems, information systems, cyber security controls, user access, digital banking, cards, alternative delivery channels, data integrity, and technology-related processes.
- Review compliance with Bangladesh Bank directives, the Bank Company Act, BFIU requirements, other applicable laws and regulations, and internal policies and procedures.
- Produce clear audit reports identifying material findings, control deficiencies, root causes, risk implications, responsible functions, and practical corrective recommendations.
- Establish tracking and follow-up processes for audit observations and ensure timely closure, particularly for high-risk, recurring, and long-outstanding findings.
- Use trend and root-cause analysis to identify systemic weaknesses and recommend improvements to processes, systems, controls, policies, and accountability.
- Undertake special audits, surprise inspections, thematic reviews, process audits, and investigations in response to emerging risks, regulatory concerns, Management/Board instructions, or control weaknesses.
- Present significant findings, major weaknesses, irregularities, unresolved observations, and corrective-action progress to the Board Audit Committee and other relevant authorities.
- Coordinate, where applicable, with Bangladesh Bank inspectors, external/statutory auditors, and other regulatory or assurance bodies, and monitor implementation of audit-related observations.
- Establish audit methodologies, working-paper standards, documentation protocols, quality assurance mechanisms, and professional standards that support consistent, accurate, independent, and effective audits.
- Promote preventive auditing by identifying emerging control risks and recommending action before significant financial, operational, regulatory, or reputational harm occurs.
- Maintain independence, objectivity, integrity, confidentiality, and professional skepticism, and protect audit activities from undue influence.
- Lead and develop the Audit team through manpower planning, deployment, professional development, specialized training, performance management, and succession planning.
- Provide independent assurance and professional insights to the Audit Committee, Board, Managing Director & CEO, and Senior Management, as applicable.

## Requirements

- Applicants must be no older than 55 years as on 24/10/2026.
- A minimum of 15 years of professional banking experience is required, with substantial exposure to Internal Audit, Audit & Inspection, Internal Control & Compliance, Credit Audit, Risk Management, Banking Operations, or related control functions.
- Applicants must have at least 3–5 years of senior-level experience in Audit & Inspection/Internal Audit, preferably in a scheduled commercial bank.
- Preference will be given to candidates currently serving, or with substantial experience, as Head of Audit, Head of Audit & Inspection, Deputy Head of ICC/Audit, or in an equivalent senior audit role.
- A master’s degree from a reputed university is required in Banking Management (MBM), Business Administration (MBA), Accounting, Finance, Management, Economics, or another relevant discipline.
- No 3rd Division/Class or equivalent result in any academic examination is permitted.
- CA, CMA, ACCA, CIA, CISA, CFE, or other recognized professional qualifications in audit, accounting, information systems audit, fraud examination, risk management, or banking are a strong advantage.
- Specialized training or certification in Risk-Based Internal Audit, Credit Audit, Internal Control, Fraud Investigation, Forensic Audit, Information Systems Audit, or Regulatory Compliance is preferred.
- Applicants must understand Bangladesh Bank’s Internal Control & Compliance guidelines, Risk-Based Internal Audit, the Bank Company Act, BFIU requirements, corporate governance requirements, and other applicable banking laws and regulations.
- Proven experience is required in branch and Head Office audits, credit audits, operational and financial audits, special audits/investigations, regulatory inspection compliance, audit follow-up, and internal control assessment.
- Applicants must have a strong understanding of credit, general banking, foreign exchange and trade finance, treasury, cards, digital banking, finance, information technology, and other major banking operations.
- Applicants must be able to identify complex and systemic control weaknesses, analyze root causes, assess financial and regulatory implications, and recommend practical, sustainable corrective measures.
- Strong professional integrity, independence, objectivity, analytical ability, professional skepticism, confidentiality, and sound judgment are required.
- Excellent leadership, report-writing, communication, presentation, investigation, and stakeholder-management skills are required.
